responsibility: Defines query result types derived from MIR analysis and transformation, such as coroutine layouts, borrow-check outputs, const qualification summaries, closure region requirements, destructured constants, and post-optimization coverage-id summaries, giving the query system stable containers for MIR-computed metadata.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `ty/query.rs`, which defines the global `TyCtxt` query machinery and the catalog of query entry points, this file only declares the value types returned by MIR-related queries. Unlike `traits/query.rs`, which specifies canonical trait-solving and type-operation query goals/results, this file is about MIR-analysis products such as borrow-check, generator/coroutine, closure outlives, const destructuring, and coverage data.
